description: Set your in-game name for this server

options.name: name
options.description: Your in-game name (max 32 chars, letters/numbers/spaces/._- only)

success.content: ✅ Your IGN has been set to **{ign}**
success.example: ✅ Your IGN has been set to **ProGamer**

update_success.content: ✅ Your IGN has been updated to **{ign}**
update_success.example: ✅ Your IGN has been updated to **CasualPlayer**

validation_empty.content: ❌ IGN cannot be empty or only whitespace
validation_empty.trigger: User provides whitespace-only input after trim

validation_characters.content: ❌ Invalid IGN: {reason}\nAllowed: letters, numbers, spaces, and ._- symbols (max 32 chars)
validation_characters.example: ❌ Invalid IGN: contains emoji\nAllowed: letters, numbers, spaces, and ._- symbols (max 32 chars)
validation_characters.trigger: User provides IGN with disallowed characters

duplicate.content: ❌ The IGN **{ign}** is already taken in this server
duplicate.example: ❌ The IGN **ProGamer** is already taken in this server
duplicate.trigger: Another user in the same server already has this IGN (case-insensitive)

database_error.content: ❌ Failed to save your IGN. Please try again.
database_error.trigger: Database connection failure or unexpected database error

unexpected_error.content: ❌ An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

database_operations.query: INSERT INTO user_igns (user_id, guild_id, ign, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (user_id, guild_id) DO UPDATE SET ign = EXCLUDED.ign, updated_at = NOW() RETURNING *
database_operations.description: Insert new IGN or update existing IGN for user in this server

parameters.ign: string (user input, will be validated and trimmed)

rules.name: check_empty
rules.error: IGN cannot be empty or only whitespace

test_cases.precondition: User has no IGN in database
test_cases.expected: ✅ Your IGN has been set to **ProGamer**
✅ Your IGN has been updated to **NewName**

test_cases.precondition: Another user has IGN 'ProGamer' in this server
test_cases.expected: ❌ The IGN **ProGamer** is already taken in this server
❌ The IGN **progamer** is already taken in this server
✅ Your IGN has been set to **Player**
❌ Invalid IGN: contains disallowed characters\nAllowed: letters, numbers, spaces, and ._- symbols (max 32 chars)
